Author: FunkyJumbo
Name: Raid Companion
Punchline: Your live DPS, rDPS and party DPS, right in the server info bar.
Description:
Shows your real-time DPS, party DPS or FFLogs-style rDPS in the server info bar, with your rank, role comparison, pace and enrage timer. Includes a live breakdown window, a compact party meter, graphs, pull history with comparisons, GCD analysis, gauge overcap, positionals, rotation errors, DoT uptime, overheal, tank swaps, party mitigation, mitigation plans, party deaths with their cause, failed mechanics, progression tracking, party DPS checks (built in for extremes and savage raids), an opener practice for every job and an opener editor to make and share your own. Works on its own, reading the fight straight from the game. Available in English, French and German (and Al Bhed).

Commands:
/raidcompanion (or /rcomp) - open / close the main window
/raidcompanion config - settings
/raidcompanion history - main window on the History tab
/raidcompanion toggle - cycle DPS, pDPS, rDPS
/raidcompanion compact - open / close the compact meter
/raidcompanion opener - open / close the opener practice
/raidcompanion opener compact - opener practice in its compact view
/raidcompanion opener full - opener practice in its full window
/raidcompanion opener edit - opener editor
/raidcompanion preset <number|name|next> - switch the server bar preset
Changelog:
- History, Personal: your rotation in the pull, as a timeline of your GCDs, oGCDs and potions (pre-pull included), with zoom.
- Mitigation plans: the group's composition (any roles), tabs (one per phase...), separators, a compact view of your position only, a duplicate button; each attack once per plan.
- Personal: the mitigation plan shown like the positionals (each skill used in time out of planned), the skills of your plan among your mitigations, and a choice of the lines shown (Settings).
- History timeline: the enemies' attacks on a lane of their own, with the mitigations up when each landed, a line following the mouse with its time, and a zoom.
- Deaths: hovering one shows the vulnerabilities on the player, the party mitigation up and the mitigation on the player when they died.
- Every section of Live and History can be hidden with a click on the dash before its title (a plus shows it again); the graph setting is gone.
- Fights by their usual name: The Unmaking EX (Enuo), AAC Heavyweight M4 (M12S), The Epic of Alexander (TEA).
- Opener: openers with the same name can be told apart, new ones get a number, a right click on the editor's list duplicates or deletes, and the full window has a size option.
- Chat summary: the example in the settings shows the values ticked only.
- Various UI changes and adjustments.
